[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-bj[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Reject non-conventional commit subjects in sase commit[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`sase commit` refuses to create a commit, proposal, or pull request[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]whose subject line is not a Conventional Commit, printing an [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]actionable error that tells the agent exactly how to rewrite it, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]while staying lenient enough that legitimate subjects, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]merge/revert/fixup subjects, and projects that opt out are never [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]blocked.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Conventional-subject grammar in the Rust core[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core_grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core_grammar: add a pure `commit_subject` domain module to sase-core [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that parses a commit subject into type/scope/breaking/description, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]classifies exemptions, and reports a stable violation code; expose it [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through the `sase_core_py` binding.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Python facade, policy config, and shared header helper[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]python_surface[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core_grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]python_surface: add the typed Python facade over the new binding, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`commit.message` configuration block with its schema and defaults, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]retarget the existing init-memory conventional-header check at the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shared helper.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reject invalid subjects in CommitWorkflow[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]commit_enforcement[dim] · [dim][/dim]after python_surface[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]commit_enforcement: gate `CommitWorkflow.run()` on the subject policy [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]before any side effect runs, render the actionable rejection message, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record the telemetry reason, and update the existing tests that commit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with non-conventional messages.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
